text:
maria: Quick sync — planning a runtime bump during the EU change window tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. Need statuspage + customer email drafts. Plan: hosted API -> pin to runtime v2.1.3; Dedicated stays on v2.1.2 unless customers opt in. Canaries first, see rollout plan below.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: id=rb-2026-04-01-22, start=2026-04-01T22:00:00Z, canary regions=[eu-west-1], maintenance-window=60m.

jess: +1 on canary. request: add automatic fallback to v2.1.2 if p95 latency > 400ms or error_rate > 0.5% for sustained 2m. Ops playbook should be scripted.

ops_lead: Proposed rollout: canary 10% for first 15m, expand to 50% for next 30m, full at 45m if all health checks pass. If any canary hold -> pause and evaluate. We'll use the existing traffic-shift job.

support: Drafting comms now. I'll paste a short statuspage blurb + customer email body for review. Keep it concise and include expected impact and rollback policy.

jess: statuspage snippet suggestion (render as code block in statuspage editor):
```
Scheduled maintenance: Runtime upgrade (hosted inference)
When: 2026-04-01 22:00 — 23:00 UTC
What: Rolling upgrade of the hosted inference runtime to v2.1.3. Expect brief canary throttling during rollout for a subset of requests.
Impact: We expect <1min of higher latency during canary shifts. No data downtime.
If you experience issues: contact support@redwood.ai or check this status page.
```

maria: Add this line to the top: "This is a non-breaking runtime upgrade; fallback to previous runtime is automatic if stability thresholds are exceeded."

support: Email subject draft: "Planned maintenance: runtime update (hosted inference) — Apr 1, 22:00 UTC"

support: Email body draft:
"Hello —

We will perform a rolling runtime update for the hosted inference service on Apr 1, 22:00 — 23:00 UTC. Most customers will see no service interruption. During the canary phase a small percentage of requests may see slightly increased latency (~1-2s).

What we're doing: upgrading hosted runtime to v2.1.3 for performance and kernel fixes.
If you use Redwood Dedicated and would like to opt into the new runtime during this window, reply to this message and we will coordinate a pinned upgrade.

Fallback plan: We will automatically roll back traffic to v2.1.2 if error rate or latency thresholds are exceeded.

Contact: support@redwood.ai (24/7)
Regards,
Redwood Inference Ops & Support"

ops_lead: Rollback playbook (short checklist):
- Isolate canary hosts
- Pin hosted traffic back to v2.1.2 via traffic-controller: `trafficctl pin --runtime=2.1.2`
- Abort rollout job and scale canary down `deploy-bot abort rb-2026-04-01-22`
- Publish statuspage update: "Investigating increased latency; rolling back to previous runtime for affected traffic."
- Escalate to on-call infra and paging if customer-facing errors persist.

sam: I'll own broadcast scheduling and the rollback runbook execution if needed. I'll run the pre-flight at 21:15 UTC and post a confirmation here. cc @ops_lead @support

deploy-bot: Canary hold condition configured: hold if (p95_latency > 400ms for 2m) OR (error_rate > 0.5% for 2m). On hold -> notify channel and pause rollout.

jess: :thumbsup: Legal review? We should avoid promising exact latency numbers in customer-facing copy. Suggest change "Expect <1min of higher latency" -> "You may see brief increases in latency for a subset of requests."

maria: Good catch. Support, please update email and statuspage copy to the softer wording. I'll ping legal now with the final copy. If no objections by 21:00 UTC we'll proceed with 21:30 pre-announce.

support: Updated both copies. Ready to send to legal. I'll attach the final text to the legal ticket and flag for 30m review.

jess: We're set on monitoring: dashboards refreshed, synthetic checks pointed at canary endpoints, and alert thresholds set.

ops_lead: Final: retention of pin info — we'll keep logs of pinned customers in `dedicated-updates` doc and run outreach after deploy to offer dedicated pin upgrades.

maria: Thanks all — will post the final statuspage URL here once published. If anyone sees unexpected alerts after 22:00, call the on-call number in the handbook and post in #eng-oncall.

sam: Preflight scheduled at 21:15 UTC. I will post smoke results in this thread.

maria: :white_check_mark:
